rows.text: Light Cone for the Path of Remembrance. The Light Cone ability is only effective for characters of this Path.

A gentle breeze scatters the clouds, revealing the face of the cosmos.
The golden glow shimmers, as epics echo through the starry sky.

"Shooting stars, encounters, promises!"
The little fairy gazes at the sky, like their first meeting, like a reunion.

"Mem, waiting. Trailblaze, the world!"
The little fairy's eyes are illuminated by starlight, twinkling like that pink tomorrow.
